name: US Global Change Research Program

summary.text: The U.S. Global Change Research Program (USGCRP) coordinates federal climate research across agencies and produces the congressionally mandated National Climate Assessment. In April 2025 the administration dismissed by email all contributors to the Sixth National Climate Assessment, following staff firings at USGCRP; on June 30, 2025 the program's website, globalchange.gov, which hosted the five published assessments, stopped working without explanation from the White House.

facts.claim: In late April 2025 the administration dismissed by email all contributors to the Sixth National Climate Assessment, saying the report's scope was being re-evaluated.
facts.quote: The email said the scope of the report "is currently being re-evaluated" and that all contributors were being dismissed.

sources.title: US dismisses all authors of National Climate Assessment, email says

facts.claim: The dismissals followed mass firings earlier in April 2025 at the U.S. Global Change Research Program, which oversees the assessment.
facts.quote: The dismissals followed mass firings earlier that month at the US Global Change Research Program (USGCRP), the body that oversees the report.

sources.title: US dismisses all authors of National Climate Assessment, email says

facts.claim: Nearly 400 contributors were dismissed, leaving the assessment, due in 2028, in doubt.
facts.quote: The dismissal of nearly 400 contributors leaves the future of the report in doubt since the multi-year, peer-reviewed analysis is due for publication in 2028.

sources.title: US dismisses all authors of National Climate Assessment, email says

facts.claim: On Monday June 30, 2025 globalchange.gov, which hosted the five published National Climate Assessments, stopped working; the White House did not explain.
facts.quote: The five assessments that have been published so far were previously available through the website globalchange.gov, but the address stopped working Monday afternoon.
